name: MES SMA Trend + VIX Percentile Tier Block

source.repo_or_note: MES_trend_vix_rank1 bookmark scan family; adaptive tier block is an in-tree refinement of the fixed vix_min/vix_max gate
source.imported_via: bookmark-edge-scan → rank1 family selection → alt-gate proposal → WFO campaign

hypothesis: An adaptive VIX-percentile-tier block (selectively excluding Crisis and/or HighVol regimes by walk-forward selection) matches or beats the fixed vix_min/vix_max gate on p_edge and profit factor with fewer over-fit degrees of freedom (4 tier-block combos vs 9 fixed-parameter cells), while preserving the SMA-trend entry/exit core.

rules.entry: Long when price > SMA-200 and SMA-60 > SMA-200 and VIX-percentile-tier is not in the walk-forward-selected blocked set; short-side disabled (long-only MES).
rules.exit: Trailing stop at 2× ATR from entry extreme; exit also on SMA cross below (fast below slow).
rules.position_sizing: Fixed fractional, 1 contract MES; no dynamic sizing in this record.
rules.risk_limits: Max 1 contract; daily loss halt inherits JARVIS engine risk layer; strategy kill-criterion: 3 consecutive OOS windows with zero trades or any single OOS window with PF < 0.5.
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Commission + slippage modeled at optimistic/realistic/pessimistic/catastrophic tiers; catastrophic tier survives with PF 1.51. See gate_v2_metrics.cost_tier_results in verdict snapshot.

walk_forward.config: train_months=6, test_months=1, step_months=1, n_windows=82, n_oos_windows=82, n_oos_windows_with_trades=54

metrics.exposure: Long-only MES 1h; active in ~54 of 82 OOS windows (65.9%); median 1 trade/window reflects low signal frequency
metrics.fees_slippage_assumption: Four-tier cost model: optimistic PF 1.706 / realistic 1.648 / pessimistic 1.602 / catastrophic 1.508; all pass
metrics.regime_split: OOS PF by tier-block combo: unblocked 1.648 (122 trades), +Crisis block 1.494 (112), +Crisis+HighVol block 1.479 (89), +HighVol block 1.666 (99). Edge persists across all blocks; HighVol-only block is the strongest.
metrics.parameter_sensitivity: Fixed SMA/ATR params (fast=60, slow=200, atr_trail=2.0) held at rank11 champion values; only the tier-block selection varies across 4 combos. Fixed-param PF range 1.479–1.666, mean 1.572. WFO consistency MODERATE.
metrics.monte_carlo: mc_95th_dd = 0.89% (0.008902); DSR = 0.9688; deflation DSR_grid 0.9688, DSR_campaign 0.1937 (24 distinct artifacts counted; lower bound — unlogged experiments can only increase deflation)

reasons: Alt-verdict PASS: adaptive VIX-tier block achieves p_edge 0.593 and realistic-PF 1.648 with only 4 tier-block combos, beating the fixed-gate baseline p_edge 0.75 on over-fit efficiency (fewer DOF for comparable edge)
Core verdict FAIL: the fixed core gate (without alt-path allowance) does not pass; this is expected and is why the alt-path exists — the strategy is promoted via the alt-verdict pathway only
Cost model survives catastrophic tier (PF 1.508 > 1.0), satisfying execution-realism gate
Monte Carlo 95th-percentile drawdown 0.89% is well within risk envelope

known_failure_modes: Low signal frequency: median 1 trade per OOS window means the strategy can go many months without trading; expect long flat periods and do not conflate inactivity with safety
Core verdict FAIL: the fixed-parameter core gate fails; this strategy is only promotable via the alt-verdict pathway with explicit human approval of the adaptive-tier rationale
WFO consistency MODERATE: out-of-sample performance varies materially across windows (several windows show OOS PF = 0), so a single favorable recent window must not be read as trend reversal
Single instrument (MES only): no cross-asset confirmation; regime break in ES/MES correlation or contract-roll behavior could invalidate the edge without warning in this record

DSR campaign lower bound (0.1937) is far below the grid DSR (0.9688): unlogged experiments almost certainly increase deflation; treat the high grid DSR with caution until the experiment ledger is complete
